name: open-compute-mcp
description: Node.js npm launcher for the Python open-compute MCP server over local stdio. Real capture and input require an interactive Windows desktop on the MCP client's host; this repository does not provide hosted desktop execution or a supported Glama/cloud-service deployment.
author: Lukas Geiger
features: Python backend: screen capture; WGC availability depends on backend configuration and platform
Python backend: Windows UI Automation targeting
Python backend: hold-input handling and release behavior
Python backend: signal tools and abort requests
Python backend: optional voice and chat tools
